mechanism: Selegiline at higher doses (>10 mg/day) exhibits non-selective MAOI activity which can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase blood pressure, counteracting eplerenone's antihypertensive and cardiac protective effects; both drugs affect potassium homeostasis.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and serum potassium levels; use selegiline at ≤10 mg/day (selective MAO-B inhibition); consider alternative antiparkinsonian agents if hypertension or hyperkalemia develops.
